raw:
```sql
SELECT AVG(avg_consumption) as monthly_avg_customer_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT CustomerID, AVG(Consumption) as avg_consumption
    FROM main."yearmonth"
    WHERE Date LIKE '201312%'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
```
